checks.claim: A tunnel boring machine's shield holds back the ground while its rotating cutter head digs.
checks.why: The cutter head turns against the face and excavates; cylindrical shields behind it support the walls until the permanent lining is built.

checks.claim: Behind the boring machine, the tunnel is lined with rings of precast concrete segments.
checks.why: ACI 533.5R: precast segment rings erected behind the TBM give ground support; the machine pushes off the completed rings.

sources.title: ACI 533.5R guide on precast tunnel segments
Colorado School of Mines: Segmental concrete liners

checks.claim: Rubber gaskets between tunnel segments are squeezed shut to keep water out.
checks.why: EPDM segment gaskets are compressed as segments are pushed together and must stay in compression to seal the joint.

checks.claim: Road tunnels use large fans to replace exhaust-filled air with fresh air.
checks.why: PIARC: tunnel ventilation dilutes vehicle emissions with fresh air and removes the exhaust; longitudinal systems use jet fans to move the air.

sources.title: PIARC Road Tunnels Manual: Tunnel ventilation system
